title: API activity not monitored
body:
Expected behaviour: Any activity under open-webui API keys associated with some user should show up in the usage report under that user's counts.

Actual behaviour: API activity does not show up in the dashboard, only the activity of the user done in the open-webui UI.
author: bborowin

comments.body: This issue has been raised multiple times, but I haven’t found a solution yet. As a workaround, you can modify OpenWebUI’s source code to reject all API requests except those from the admin.

> This issue has been raised multiple times, but I haven’t found a solution yet.

Why close the issue then? Someone will just open it again, it's an obvious use case. "Reject all API requests except admin" is not a solution -- this tool's value is not related to managing access, it's about monitoring usage.

Better idea to reopen it, use this as a place for a discussion on how to implement, prototype a fix and eventually merge the new functionality.

title: 是否有计划实现图片的token计费？
author: RedwindA

comments.body:
模型提供商对图片 token 的计价方式各不相同，例如：
- OpenAI 采用 base token + tiles 数量
- Gemini 采用固定的 258 个 token
- Anthropic 采用 `tokens = (width px * height px)/750`

想要精确计算图片的 token 消耗是非常繁琐的，需要手动适配各个厂商的计算方式。如果不要求精确计算，不妨把模型价格调高一点。

我可能没有足够的精力开发此功能。如果你愿意的话，可以帮忙开发。
